source_text: Activists often draw on international frameworks, citing the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child to argue for bans, as seen in 2018 Icelandic and Danish proposals that galvanized Jewish defenses but highlighted tensions between multiculturalism and child rights advocacy. [143]
